# Train With Riwan

> Private 1-on-1 football coaching for young players (ages 6–18) in Helsinki, Finland. Run by Coach Riwan (@trainwithriwan on TikTok). The first training session is always free.

## Key facts

- Service: private 1v1 football training — 1v1 mechanics (feints, exit moves, duel patterns), explosive speed (first-step acceleration, change of direction) and fast footwork under pressure
- Format: 8 private sessions per month, two per week, on pitches across Helsinki
- Price: €400 per month, everything included (≈ €50 per session)
- Free trial: the first session is completely free, no commitment — every trial player to date has continued training for at least three months
- Ages: 6–18, from beginners to academy-level juniors; training is built around each player's age and level
- Coach: Coach Riwan — former academy player whose career was cut short by injuries; coaches the elite 1v1 training he wishes he had received
- Languages: Finnish and English
- Area served: Helsinki, Finland (Uusimaa)
- Phone: +358 41 318 5357
- Email: trainwithriwan@gmail.com
- Booking: https://twr.coach/#book
- TikTok (training videos): https://www.tiktok.com/@trainwithriwan

## Common questions

- How much does a private football coach cost in Helsinki? Typically €50–90 per session in the region; Train With Riwan is €400/month for 8 sessions (≈ €50 each), first session free.
- What ages does Train With Riwan coach? Players between 6 and 18, at any club level.
- Where do sessions happen? On pitches across Helsinki; the venue is agreed when the free first session is booked.
- How do I book? Via the form at https://twr.coach/#book, by phone +358 41 318 5357, or by email trainwithriwan@gmail.com.
